title: Qarinah: Less Context. More Proof.
description: Implementation-backed technical white paper for Qarinah 0.1.6. Version 1.4 adds the audited current-product v0.5 differential reproduction and the frozen context-efficiency comparison v2 no-primary-result outcome. Measured claims remain scoped to their named committed fixtures and portable estimator.
notes: This manuscript is not peer reviewed. The 98.71% figure is a portable estimated input-context reduction in a named six-task fixture, not a universal provider-token, cost, latency, or task-success claim. Qarinah and admission-filtered BM25 produced no primary comparative result in context-efficiency comparison v2.
